texts.Memberships_Erase_NeedAccess: To erase a member you also need Memberships Admin or Memberships Staff. Nothing was erased.
texts.Memberships_Cert_ErrorCredits: Not enough credits to renew: {0} earned, {1} needed.
texts.Memberships_Cert_ErrorNeverExpires: This certification does not expire, so there is nothing to renew.
texts.Memberships_Cert_ErrorNotFound: The certification was not found, or you cannot see it.
texts.Memberships_Cert_ErrorNotHeld: Only an active or expired certification can be renewed. Use Grant for a pending or revoked one.
texts.Memberships_Error_CannotRenew: Only a current, grace or lapsed membership can be renewed.
texts.Memberships_Error_LinkNotSent: A membership payment link was not sent: the membership, Payments or the payment link email template was not found.
texts.Memberships_Error_NoDues: This membership's level has no dues, so there is nothing to pay.
texts.Memberships_Error_NoEmail: The member has no email address. Add one to the contact first.
texts.Memberships_Error_NoTemplate: Renewal reminders are on but the reminder email template was not found or is not active. Check Reminder template in BarnCRM Settings, Memberships.
texts.Memberships_Error_NotFound: The membership was not found, or you cannot edit it.
texts.Memberships_Error_PaymentsNotReady: Payments is not ready: install it, turn it on and enter the processor keys on Payments Setup.
texts.Memberships_Error_SendFailed: {0} of {1} membership emails were not sent: {2}
texts.Memberships_Nightly_Step: Memberships: renew from gifts, lapse, remind and expire certifications
texts.Memberships_Panel_CannotRenew: This membership has been renewed or cancelled, so there is nothing to renew here.
texts.Memberships_Panel_Failed: Something went wrong. Try again, or check the Error Log.
texts.Memberships_Panel_LinkQueued: The payment link email is on its way to the member.
texts.Memberships_Panel_NoEmail: Add an email address to the member's contact to email a payment link.
texts.Memberships_Panel_PaymentsOff: Turn on Payments to email the member a payment link.
texts.Memberships_Portal_LinkSent: We have emailed you a link to pay your dues.
texts.Memberships_Home_Intro: Who belongs, who is due to renew and who has just renewed. Active counts current and grace-period memberships; Expiring counts current memberships that end in the next 30 days; Renewals counts memberships that follow an earlier one, added in the last 30 days.
texts.Memberships_Home_NoExpiring: Nothing expires in the next 30 days
texts.Memberships_Home_NoExpiringNext: Memberships show here once their end date is 30 days away or less.
texts.Memberships_Home_NoRenewals: No renewals in the last 30 days
texts.Memberships_Home_NoRenewalsNext: Open an expiring membership and choose Renew to start its next term.
texts.Memberships_Home_LevelFirstMessage: A level sets the dues and how long a membership lasts. Create one, then add your first member.
texts.Memberships_Home_MemberFirstMessage: Create a membership for a person or organization at one of your levels.
texts.Memberships_Home_LoadFailed: Memberships Home did not load. Try again. If it happens again, ask your BarnCRM admin to check the Error Log.
